notes.title: Introducing the Supporter Edition of Architect Life
notes.content:
Architect Life launches on June 19, and whether you’re planning to build sleek studios or cozy dream homes, we’ve got something extra special for players who want the complete creative experience from day one.

[h2]What’s included in the Supporter Edition?[/h2]
The Supporter Edition includes the [b]full base game[/b], along with [b]two themed content packs[/b] that give your architectural projects even more personality and flair: perfect for players who want to further support the game and the developers while unlocking extra creative content.
Here's what you will find in it: 

[h3]The Sketch House Pack🎨[/h3]
Play with perception and perspective. This pack introduces unique decorative elements that bring 2D optical illusions into your 3D world: perfect for bold, artistic builds that defy convention.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/99af770f9cda6eecb5a022a62e4a87fc786b9f21.png[/img]

[h3]The Hobbies pack🎶🏀[/h3]
Design spaces dedicated to downtime. From music rooms to crafting corners and reading nooks, the Hobbies Pack includes items to help you create the ultimate leisure and lifestyle rooms for your clients or yourself.
Whether you're designing for relaxation, passion projects, or playful aesthetics, these packs give your builds more story, style, and soul.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/037f5451de7e699bfa47a2dbbbd115380433ae39.png[/img]

[h2]Early Buyer Bonus: Get the Architect’s Home Office Pack Free![/h2]
To thank early players for their support, anyone - [b]Supporter Edition or not[/b] - who purchases Architect Life during the first 7 days after launch will receive the Architect’s Home Office Pack for free! 

This exclusive bonus pack includes carefully selected décor and tools to create the perfect architect’s personal space — blending style, creativity, and authenticity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/57792c9f0411658783012a9b47c9ae39002dbcb1.png[/img]

[h3]What's inside ?[/h3]
[list]
[*] A classic sloped drafting table paired with a wooden stool - the cornerstone of any studio
[*] A sleek designer floor lamp and desk lamp to light up your ideas
[*] A basket of blueprints and rolled-up drafts to fill your space with work-in-progress energy
[*] A handcrafted wooden blueprint sideboard and shelving unit to keep your tools stylishly organized
[*] A curated set of architect's tools for that detailed finishing touch
[*] A wooden articulated mannequin to help you plan or just look cool on a shelf
[*] A vibrant musa basjoo plant - a calming, green presence in your work zone
[*] A modern desktop computer to help you handle digital designs like a pro
[*] A set of paintings to add atmosphere and character
[*] And of course... your invaluable coffee mug — the true companion of all-night design marathons
[/list]

Wishlist now, and get ready to start your design journey on June 19!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1296400/Architect_Life_A_House_Design_Simulator/

notes.title: Archiblog #7: Games modes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/a5847fc1f1ad4db59c9960b334fa037435d961c3.jpg[/img]
Welcome to our Archiblog #7!

We’re now just about two months away from the launch of Architect Life! Our team is still hard at work refining the game based on the feedback you shared with us during the demo earlier this year. Right now we are focusing on improving the tutorial and the keyboard/mouse experiences.

Today, let’s take a closer look at the[b] different game modes[/b] you’ll be able to enjoy when Architect Life launches this June: [b]Tutorial[/b], [b]Career[/b], and [b]Free Mode[/b].

Whether you're a methodical planner or a creative spirit, Architect Life offers several ways to enjoy life as an architect, your way.
 
[h1]1-Tutorial[/h1]
[b]Learn the basics of architecture, step by step.[/b]
 
The tutorial mode is designed for new players or those who want to familiarize themselves with the game’s tools and mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/6a7e25ba0c5f608a0848d10c2f7fb959d2ffe474.jpg[/img]
[b]🔹 Goal:[/b] Learn the fundamentals of design and construction at your own pace.

[b]🔹 What to expect:[/b][list]
[*] Get introduced to core design tools (walls, roofs, windows, furniture, and more).
[*] Understand key rules and constraints: materials, budget, and structural logic.
[*] Hands-on practicing to place elements, adjust dimensions, and decorate spaces.
[*] Follow guided scenarios to see how various components interact.
[/list][b]📌 Best for:[/b] Beginners and players who want to master the mechanics before jumping into bigger projects.

In our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1296400/announcements/detail/614283652169203747]previous Archiblog[/url], we talked to you about the revamped tutorial we're working on based on your feedback during the demo. Our goal? To deliver a smoother, more intuitive first experience that follows the natural phases of an architectural project, from conception to delivery.

To make things clearer, we’ve structured the tutorial into three main sections: Fundamentals, Delivery, and Advanced. You’ll progress step by step using the standard UI and gameplay features, starting with essential tools. Each step of the tutorial will also be shorter, more dynamic, and easier to follow, with fewer text blocks and more visual guidance. All tutorials will be available from the start so you can choose to do the ones fitting your needs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/4c356b575936944ccea7d48085e28246eea38ba6.jpg[/img]
[h1]2-Career[/h1]
[b]Climb the ladder, become a renowned architect and lead increasingly ambitious projects! [/b]

In career mode, you start as a young architect and work your way up by completing contracts and designing various buildings.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/e0a2398f5b9af92f973525d3f66ff9e9c040c3aa.png[/img]
[b]🔹 Goal[/b]: Build your reputation, manage your cash balance, and satisfy client expectations.

[b]🔹 What to expect:[/b]
[list]
[*] Progressively complex contracts: Start with small project and progressively get access to more complex structures, challenges and skills. 
[*] Budget and resource management: Work with limited budget, optimize space, and follow regulations.
[*] Demanding clients: Some have specific design preferences, while others have tight budgets, learn to balance constraints.
[*] Unlock skills and innovations: Adapt to obstacles and tackle challenges thanks to advanced perks earned through experience.[/list]
[b]📌 Best for: [/b]Players who enjoy progression, diverse challenges, and strategic decision-making.

[h1]3-Free Build[/h1]
[b]Create your dream home! No limits, just creativity![/b]
 
Free mode is made for players who want full freedom to design whatever they can imagine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/12d46b3f81bca960e5ec0907097a89e96488226f.jpg[/img]

[b]🔹 Goal:[/b] Let your imagination run wild with no constraints.

[b]🔹 What to expect:[/b]
[list][*] No budgets or restrictions: Build freely without financial constraints.
[*] Build anything: From huge villas to cozy cottages or even wild experiments / recreate your own home.
[*] Custom challenges: Create your own rules, design an energy-efficient home, or build a tiny house with max functionality.[/list]
[b]📌 Best for: [/b]Creative minds who love experimentation and pushing architectural boundaries.
Which mode are you most excited to try? Let us know in the comments!

_________

We’re incredibly excited as we get closer to the launch of Architect Life! The whole team is working hard to make sure everything is ready for you to dive in and start building this June.

Don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam if you haven’t already, it really helps and ensures you won’t miss any updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1296400/Architect_Life_A_House_Design_Simulator/

And stay tuned: a brand-new trailer is coming early next month!

See you soon!

[b]- The Architect Life Team 🏡[/b]

notes.title: Archiblog #6: A Message from the devs
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/cde6490770797f426df6be1d7492387d82710fed.jpg[/img]

For this sixth edition of the Archiblog, we want to take a moment to thank you. After two weeks of the demo, what an incredible experience it has been for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1296400/Architect_Life_A_House_Design_Simulator/]Architect Life[/url]!

We’ve seen the community of future architects grow steadily, and it’s an absolute honor to share this journey with you.

Your feedback, in all its forms, is invaluable to us. It helps us refine and improve the game continuously. We’ve loved engaging with you and involving you in the game’s evolution.

[h1]Upcoming changes[/h1]

That’s why we’re actively working on improvements based on your input after the demo. Here’s what we’re already focusing on:
[list]
[*] Keyboard/Mouse controls improvement
[*] UI & navigation improvement
[*] Addition of Imperial Measure system option (inches/feets units)
[*] A complete tutorial rework
[/list]
Regarding the tutorial, we want to provide a new learning experience that introduces the gameplay in a structured, step-by-step approach, mirroring both the game’s progression and the key phases of an architectural project. Using the standard UI and functions, you'll advance logically and progressively.

The tutorial will guide you from the basics, starting with essential tools and the initial conception phase, through construction and delivery. Advanced tools will be available for you to explore at your own pace.

Our goal is to make the first experience in the game more intuitive, streamlined, and engaging, with a clearer flow, less text, more highlights and shorter! You’ll be able to navigate more freely, jump into creation faster, and choose when to explore advanced tools.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/e2bed6564397d788a44fdb2a90393d7bf403f354.jpg[/img]
We hope you enjoyed the demo, and we can’t wait to see you all on June 5 for the launch of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1296400/Architect_Life_A_House_Design_Simulator/]Architect Life[/url]!

There’s still time to join the team of future architects! Come chat with us on [url=https://discord.gg/4wcny2cunu]Discord[/url], and follow us on [url=https://www.instagram.com/ArchiLifeGame]Instagram[/url], [url=https://x.com/ArchiLifeGame]X (Twitter)[/url], and all our social media channels.

To wrap things up, here are a few words from Émile and Rémy, two of Architect Life’s programmers. 

[b]Émile, Programmer:[/b]
[quote][i]"So many people played the Architect Life demo and showed great interest in it. We received tons of valuable feedback that will help us make the game even better. A huge thank you to all the demo players, your input is what drives the game forward!"[/i][/quote]
[b]Rémy, Programmer:[/b]
[quote][i]"Thank you for all your feedback on the demo! It was a real pleasure to watch you play on stream and see all the content you shared. We know there’s room for improvement, especially in the tutorial, and we’re already working on a complete rework. We can’t wait to show you what’s next and continue this adventure together!"[/i][/quote]
[url=https://discord.gg/4wcny2cunu][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/09eb078acf6a9a61eb3c10feb4ff9538bbe87c12.png[/img][/url]
As we move forward, your support and feedback remain at the heart of Architect Life's development. Every comment, suggestion, and shared experience helps shape the game into something truly special.

The journey doesn’t end here! We’ll be sharing more trailers next month.

Until then, join us on our socials, and let’s continue crafting Architect Life together!

See you soon!

[b]- The Architect Life Team 🏡[/b]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/e5f0401b5077eeae01a9761f2b5e1eebf6e93d99.jpg[/img]

Hello Architects!

Thank you for playing Architect Life and for all your valuable feedback on our [url=https://discord.gg/4wcny2cunu]Discord[/url] or on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1296400/discussions/]Steam forums[/url]! 

In this update, we’ve addressed several community-reported issues, including a fix for the language selection bug and improvements to overall stability.

We've also implemented an initial solution for multiple crash reports. However, if you continue to experience any crashes, please let us know so we can investigate further!
[url=https://discord.gg/4wcny2cunu][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/09eb078acf6a9a61eb3c10feb4ff9538bbe87c12.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Architect Life Demo - Patch 1[/h1]

[h2]Improvements and Fixes:[/h2]
[list][*][b]Language Selection Bug [/b] - Performing a clean install (deleting the Architect folder in AppData) should prevent the language prompt from appearing on the first boot in the demo version. However, after this initial setup, language changes and reboots should function correctly.
[*][b]AZERTY Keyboard Issue[/b] - Due to limited reports, we are still investigating this issue further.
[/list][h2]Stability improvements[/h2]
We've implemented initial fixes for the following crashes. In our tests, these issues were not reproduced on our end anymore, but we are continuing to investigate. If you still encounter these crashes, please report them to us.
[list]
[*] Crash when moving a wall in the demo.
[*] Crash when placing a door on a wall while the building is surrounded by fences.
[*] Crash when separating a fenced area with a room inside.
[*] Crash after deleting a curved fence.
[*] Crash after placing fences around a specific house.
[*] Crash related to placing interior doors on partitions.
[*] Crash occurring while playing in Free Mode.
[*] Crash when using the "Move a Wall" feature.
[*] Crash related to the Wall Edit tool.
[/list]

Thank you for your support and feedback!

[b]- The Architect Life Team 🏡[/b]

notes.title: Archiblog #5 - From blueprint to reality
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/8b564bf9ac8cba4c9a36c0f2ae4a3dc01d3724e4.jpg[/img]
Hello, aspiring architects!

In our previous articles, we introduced various specific aspects and tools of the game. Today, for this fifth Archiblog, we’re taking a broader look. We’ll walk you through how a project unfolds from start to finish in Career Mode in [i][b]Architect Life: A House Design Simulator[/b][/i]!

[h1]Time to start your project[/h1]
First things first, before you begin a new project, you need to choose one! At each stage of your career, you’ll have a selection of [b]three different projects[/b]. These projects are determined by your reputation, which you gradually build by successfully completing projects. The more satisfied your clients are, the more your reputation grows, unlocking access to bigger and more ambitious projects!

Once you’ve chosen your project, [b]it’s time to get to work[/b]! Design your house, outline its shape, define and furnish its rooms, choose materials, and much more.

When your design is complete, it’s time to build. Select the construction companies that will handle different phases of the project, each with its own pricing, deadlines, and reliability.

After making your choices, you’ll oversee the construction process on-site. Various events, such as bad weather or unexpected incidents, may disrupt the project. It’s up to you to make the right decisions to keep the project on schedule and within budget.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/dd287fc1e62ac0620f5d4c71ec108c7f1bec937f.gif[/img]

[h1]Construction completed![/h1]
Once construction is finished, you can finally explore your creation! With a [b]first-person view[/b], immerse yourself in the house you designed and built, within its unique setting. Each project has its own environment and atmosphere.

After your visit, it’s time to see if your project meets the client’s expectations. Their satisfaction depends on how well you followed the project’s requirements. [b]The better you fulfill their requests, the happier they’ll be[/b]. Each completed project also grants you experience points, which unlock perks, new tools, and additional options for future projects. If you manage to satisfy your client, you’ll also keep any unused portion of the project’s budget, helping your agency stay afloat and continue growing your career.

That wraps up our overview of how a project unfolds in [i][b]Architect Life: A House Design Simulator[/b][/i]! Beyond [b]Career Mode[/b], you’ll also have access to [b]Free Mode[/b], where you can take on individual projects, revisit houses you’ve previously completed, or simply let your creativity run wild without restrictions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/779d4953241987d77015a680fa21cb5b18999238.gif[/img]

[h1]The free demo arrives next week![/h1]
As we mentioned in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1296400/view/515199484641149117?l=english]Archiblog #4[/url], a free demo for Architect Life is launching on [b]February 19[/b], just one week away! We’ll share more details in a dedicated News post, but the demo will give you an extensive preview of the game.

You’ll have access to a limited number of plots compared to the full game, but don’t worry, you’ll have plenty of space to create your dream home or experiment with your wildest ideas!

In the demo, you’ll find:
[list]
[*] A preview of the [i]Career Mode[/i], featuring two client missions with project requirements and a budget.
[*] A glimpse of [i]Free Build Mode[/i], allowing you to construct your dream house.
[*] 2 construction lands to work with.
[*] And to fully unleash your creativity, you’ll have access to all the house editing tools and a selection of doors, windows, furniture, and decorations!
[/list]
We can’t wait to see you all next week, [b]February 19 on Steam[/b]! 🚀

notes.title: Archiblog #4 - Roofs & Steam Demo Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, aspiring architects! Welcome to the fourth Archiblog! Today, we’re spotlighting an essential feature of [i]Architect Life[/i]: [b]Roofs[/b]!

In the second part of this Archiblog, we’ll talk about the demo. Yes, you’ll soon be able to build your dream home in the [b]free Architect Life demo[/b], coming in just under a month!

[previewyoutube=dHBFZvjm_qc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]BUILDING ROOFS[/h2]

In Architect Life, you have complete freedom to design your roofs just the way you envision them. Simply draw the desired shape, and the game will automatically generate the roof based on the type you’ve selected.

Prefer a quicker option? With the [b]automatic shape detection feature[/b], you can cover ceilings with just one click!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/5d69e7ac487d364874b09ddf9de0a80f830aa720.gif[/img]

Once your roof is created, you can fine-tune it using tools to adjust its height, orientation, and how it connects to the walls.

And of course, your roof deserves a stunning finish! During the [b]Finishing work phase[/b], choose from a variety of materials to give your rooftop the perfect look.

With five unique roof types and versatile tools, [i]Architect Life[/i] provides endless possibilities for designing buildings with truly distinctive silhouettes.

Stay tuned for more insights into the creative features of Architect Life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/070cc9815fb57e2bb5d5b4324c81243ad8237f29.gif[/img]

[h2]FREE DEMO starting February 19th[/h2]

Get ready to unleash your creativity!

The [i]Architect Life[/i] demo arrives on [b]February 19th[/b] on Steam. Take an exclusive first look at our architect simulator, where you’ll design homes your way, tackle ambitious projects, and bring your boldest architectural visions to life.

This is your chance to test your skills and immerse yourself in the captivating world of Architect Life ahead of its official release. Your feedback will be invaluable in helping us fine-tune the game!

Mark your calendars for [b]February 19th[/b] and begin your journey as a visionary architect!

notes.title: Archiblog #3 - Housebuilding
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/5b485bde69b6c16ebb5f439b1c9a927330b4e894.jpg[/img]

Hello, aspiring architects! 

In this new Archiblog, we will dive deeper into the tools you’ll have access to for designing your home.

In the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1296400/view/6403638956412575073?l=english]first Archiblog[/url], we showed you how to draw walls and manipulate your rooms. These tools are part of the first design phase (there are 5 in total): [b]Structural Work[/b]!

[previewyoutube=hEijAwG5AlM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]HOUSEBUILDING: Structural Work[/h2]
Let’s see what else this phase has in store.

During the Structural Work phase, you’ll place the stairs, doors, windows, and balconies of your home.

Stairs are placed directly on the ground, and once set, they automatically create an opening adapted to the shape on the floor above.

Doors and windows align automatically with the wall under your cursor to spare you tedious placement. There are many doors and windows of various sizes and styles to let you imagine and test countless designs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/90ba380abf2e6f6b8ccbdec5a34a584c3ad050b9.gif[/img]

Balconies are created by placing barriers, which are drawn just like walls. By creating a closed shape at a height, poles automatically appear to support your structure.

Now, let’s take a quick look at the second design phase: [b]Finishing Work[/b]! 

The main function in the [b]Finishing Work[/b] phase is to place all the coverings in your home. Tiles, parquet, or marble for your floors. And plaster, paint, or wallpaper for your walls. Architect Life offers a wide variety of coverings that can drastically influence the atmosphere and style of your creation!

SPEAKING OF!

[h2]HOLIDAY SEASON[/h2]

As the holiday season approaches, you may have noticed the arrival of a brand-new biome in Architect Life: [b]the mountains[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/00ff6a68ec83f25230df125a7118ff0de000affa.gif[/img]

This is the perfect opportunity to build the chalet of your dreams, nestled in the heart of snowy mountains or by frozen lakes. Let your imagination run wild to create a true winter cocoon, complete with optimized heating systems to fully enjoy this warm and relaxing atmosphere. We’ll tell you more about the indoor heating system in a future Archiblog!

During this festive period, the entire Architect Life team wishes you very happy holidays.
We’ll see you again in [b]2025[/b], a year that promises to be particularly important for us: it will mark the official release of Architect Life!

Thank you for your support, and see you soon for more architectural adventures!

[b]- The Architect Life Team 🏡[/b]

notes.title: Archiblog #1 - Putting up walls!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/7c87ba9f306213e6f9250a2cb722c2dade232131.jpg[/img]
Hello future architects, 

Thank you for all the support since the announcement of Architect Life: A House Design Simulator. We're pushing along with development and want to share that journey with you through a series of dev blogs. That starts with Archiblog #1 - Putting up walls!

Each build starts at your desk where you'll create the design for your next creation and the first step is to add some structure. And to do that, you'll need walls!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/4771f85738308daa0690c1e71beba2c46e16822a.jpg[/img]
We created our tools to give you freedom while presenting all the information you'd need to build walls and rooms of any shape. Grids, tooltips, and other aids will help you set precise angles or keep things symmetrical (if you're as oddly specific about that as I am). Also yes, that includes curved walls, but this feature is still WIP so we'll show it off in more detail later. 

When you've got the building design down, you can fine-tune it by merging and separating parts or moving walls to create extensions at the press of a button. After which, you can define from which materials you wish to build and later expand on this by adding paint, or wall coverings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/a2e24c60e56688a1d68ac84a7523bcb24d4c883b.jpg[/img]
Additionally, there are two camera modes from which you can view your creation. The 360 rotational view gives complete control of what you're looking at and the top-down view can help put your designs into perspective. You can zoom in as necessary or draw back when you want to get an idea of the scope of what you've been building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/fae34f6a758b75373219a8347ebb19027cc5279e.jpg[/img]
We've put together a short video showing off some of these features below for those who want a closer look at how development is coming along! 

[previewyoutube=LjRrRlCYnc8;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Note:[/b] The video is using the French language version of the game, we're a French studio, sorry about that, but we'll share the English version in the future.
